questions.solution_html:

  • Low-Fidelity Prototype:
  • • Simple and rough • Cheap and fast • Used in early stages
  • High-Fidelity Prototype:
  • • Detailed and realistic • Costly and time-consuming • Used in final stages
  • Examples:
  • • Low-fidelity: Paper sketch
  • • High-fidelity: Interactive app demo
